🖥 MoonPay CLI Reference — mp commands ▸ click to expand
All commands run locally. Keys never leave your machine. Selected chain: solana
Setup
npm i -g @moonpay/cliInstall MoonPay CLI globally
mp consent acceptAccept terms of service
mp loginAuthenticate with MoonPay account
mp mcpStart MCP server for AI agent integration
Wallet (non-custodial · keys local)
mp wallet createCreate a new local wallet
mp wallet listList all local wallets
mp wallet retrieve <id>Show wallet details by ID
mp wallet export <id>Export wallet private key (use with care)
Balances
mp token balance list --wallet <addr> --chain solanaList all token balances on chain
mp bitcoin balance retrieveBTC balance (Bitcoin chain only)
Market Data
mp token trending --chain solanaTrending tokens on selected chain
mp token search --query <symbol>Search for token by name or symbol
mp token retrieve --token <id>Full token metadata, price, and metrics
Trade
mp token swap --from SOL --to USDC --chain solanaSame-chain swap (e.g. SOL → USDC)
mp token bridge --from solana --to ethereum --token USDCCross-chain bridge (requires both chains)
Fiat On/Off Ramp
mp buy --token sol --amount 100Fiat-to-crypto on-ramp (USD → SOL)
mp sell --token sol --amount 0.5Crypto-to-fiat off-ramp
mp virtual-account createCreate virtual bank account for deposits
mp buy --token usdc --zero-feeZero-fee stablecoin on-ramp (USDC/USDT)

🔗 WORKFLOW CHAINS
Put your agents to work in a line — each one's result is handed to the next.
New here? A chain is a recipe: pick agents in order, tell each one what to do, and hit Run. Agent 1 does its job, then Agent 2 builds on that result, and so on. These run on the real agent engine — each agent uses its real tools (web search, prices, files, security checks…). Type {step1} in a later step to reuse an earlier result.

⚡ Commerce — the x402 Agent Economy checking rail…
Pay agents to do work — and let agents pay each other — over x402, the open HTTP-402 stablecoin standard (USDC on Base or Solana). Non-custodial: nothing leaves your wallet without your signature.
How it works: ① top up a prepaid balance → ② hire an agent for a task → ③ the cost is debited from your balance and the agent runs. (Beta: top-ups are simulated until you connect a wallet.)

          🔌
          USE AURA IN YOUR OWN AI TOOLS (MCP)
        

        
AURA ships an MCP server. Add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or Cursor and it saves tokens automatically — answering repeat prompts for free before your model spends anything.


        
CLAUDE CODE — one line

        

          claude mcp add aura -- npx -y -p shaddai-aura aura-mcp
          
        


        
CLAUDE DESKTOP / CURSOR — config JSON

        

          { "mcpServers": { "aura": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y","-p","shaddai-aura","aura-mcp"] } } }
          
        


        

          
          
        

        
Three tools: aura_ask (free answer first) · aura_remember (cache it) · aura_stats (savings). Zero dependencies, MIT.

🔗 Automated Workflows

      
Multi-agent pipelines — each agent hands off to the next automatically via the Network router (port 8003)


      

        
📊 → ⚡ Alpha to Post

        
ZEROX analyzes a token → SHADDAI writes a formatted alpha group post. Ready to send to Telegram.

        

          ZEROX:analyze
          →
          SHADDAI:write_post
        

        

          
          
        

      


      

        
🌙 → 📊 World Event → Market Play

        
ORACLE researches a world event → ZEROX identifies the best market position/trade from that macro intel.

        

          ORACLE:research
          →
          ZEROX:find_trade
        

        

          
          
        

      


      

        
🌙 → 🐢 → ⚡ Intel to Content

        
ORACLE pulls world intelligence → TURTLE applies creative brand lens → SHADDAI writes platform-ready content.

        

          ORACLE
          →
          TURTLE
          →
          SHADDAI
        

        

          
          
          
        

      


      

        
☀️ Morning Briefing

        
ORACLE world pulse + ZEROX market pulse + SHADDAI daily priorities. Full situational awareness in 30 seconds.

        

          ORACLE:pulse
          +
          ZEROX:pulse
          →
          SHADDAI:brief
